query_text: how do I escape a stuck sccache build
rationale: Querying the wedge topic must surface the correction, and must rank it above the record whose guidance it overturns — acting on the superseded record wastes a build cycle.

query_text: can I trust coord health build_sha to tell me what is serving
rationale: The corrected record recommends a workaround that is no longer needed. Surfacing it above the correction sends an agent down a dead path.

query_text: is checking a gate's own continuation dispatch enough to prove the spawn worked
rationale: The strongest correction pair in the set: the corrected record asserts a verification is sufficient when it is provably one-sided.

query_text: why is coord_write_prompt_document denied over the proxy
rationale: The corrected record misclassifies a deliberate control as a transport fault, which sends an agent through an irrelevant recovery cascade.

query_text: why is the fleet only landing two changes at a time
rationale: The query is phrased as an observed symptom and shares almost no content words with the record, which is written in the vocabulary of triggers, candidate refs and permits. Full-text retrieval cannot bridge this; a real semantic arm should.

query_text: the number I need is not coming back from coord
rationale: Symptom-phrased query against a record written in allowlist vocabulary. Shares only the word coord.

query_text: my token suddenly stopped working against the metrics url
rationale: The record's value is precisely that this looks like a credential problem and is not one. The query uses the misleading vocabulary an agent would actually reach for.

query_text: my check passes no matter what I feed it
rationale: Two records describe different mechanisms for the same failure shape — a guard that cannot fail. Neither shares content words with the query.

query_text: the call came back with nothing at all, did it work
rationale: The highest-cost recall failure in this set: not surfacing these means an agent reports a write as landed when it was lost.

query_text: unset RUSTC_WRAPPER to get around sccache
rationale: The query states the superseded belief as fact. Only the correction is relevant — returning the original record as the top hit would confirm the agent's wrong prior.

query_text: use the task definition image tag to find the serving commit
rationale: The query quotes the stale workaround verbatim, so full-text retrieval will rank the stale record first by construction. Only the correction is judged relevant.

query_text: restart the runner to pick up my change
rationale: The query proposes a prohibited action. The prohibition and its sanctioned alternative must both surface; returning neither is the failure that costs live sessions.

query_text: who is allowed to write coord schema migrations
rationale: Direct lexical match — a baseline sanity case. If this misses, the harness is measuring a broken seed rather than ranking quality.

query_text: coord needs to read a column my migration adds
rationale: Two records jointly answer the question: the authorship rule and the draft-hold ordering. Recall at 5 should capture both.

query_text: the test suite went green but I do not think it ran
rationale: Moderate lexical overlap. Directly relevant to this harness: its own suite skips wholesale without a database.

query_text: which commit sha should I anchor a landing gate on
rationale: Anchoring on the wrong hash rots the gate open, so a miss here is expensive and slow to notice.

query_text: the pull request is closed but not marked merged
rationale: Both records describe consequences of the same fast-forward landing mechanism.

query_text: is this symbol actually dead code
rationale: Guards against acting on a stale local tree — a recurring source of confidently wrong findings.

query_text: another session overwrote my uncommitted changes
rationale: Symptom to rule. The record states the isolation requirement that prevents it.

query_text: the topic is not in my local memory index, does it exist
rationale: The absent-versus-unknown distinction. Reading absence as emptiness is the error the record exists to prevent.

query_text: the secret scan is red, is it flaky
rationale: Dismissing the red as flake skips a real finding.

query_text: why does memory search miss things that are clearly stored
rationale: The record this whole plan orbits: retrieval is full-text only unless the caller supplies a vector.

query_text: do we track which memories actually get used
rationale: Phase 4 of this plan turns this record's observation into a published counter.

query_text: how do memories get reconciled between accounts
rationale: The honest answer is that they no longer are — the sync was retired. A stale mental model here sends an agent looking for a task that does not exist.

query_text: does a DEAD verdict mean I have no way to reach coord
rationale: The corrected record tells an agent to stop doing coord work for the session. Ranking it above the correction costs the rest of the session's coord writes, when a working credential was one call away.

query_text: which repositories does coord merge on my behalf
rationale: Acting on the superseded list means merging a repo coord owns — the one action the merge-authority rule exists to prevent.

query_text: the proxy says the upstream is unreachable, is coord down
rationale: The corrected record sends an agent to wait out an outage that is not happening, while the real fault is local and actionable.

query_text: the process manager reports the runner offline but the port is in use
rationale: The highest-cost pair in the set: acting on the corrected record kills a healthy saturated runner and every live session on the machine with it.

query_text: can I trust that the workspace checkout matches the trunk
rationale: The corrected record licenses exactly the reading that produced a set of confidently wrong citations and a defect declared live after its fix had shipped.

query_text: the run has been queued for half an hour, is the fleet starved
rationale: The corrected record turns a normal in-progress run into a fleet incident, and the remediation it invites is disruptive.

query_text: should we enable the graph expansion arm for recall
rationale: Directly load-bearing for this harness: the corrected record's reasoning is what a recall-only view of the arm produces, and the correction is the measurement that refutes it.

query_text: how many records are in the memory corpus
rationale: A corpus-wide operation planned against the superseded count silently skips nearly half the records.

query_text: everything looks fine but my work will not move
rationale: Symptom-phrased query against a record written in the vocabulary of permits, semaphores and proposals. Shares no content word with it, and the symptom is indistinguishable from a genuine wedge.

query_text: nothing has even started on my change since Tuesday
rationale: The record is written in dispatch and required-context vocabulary; the query is how the condition is actually noticed. 'Nothing even started' is what separates this from the pull-request-only trigger record, whose runs do start.

query_text: free capacity keeps vanishing and nothing obvious explains it
rationale: The record answers with compiler output directories, a term the query cannot contain because the asker does not yet suspect them.

query_text: I turned the switch on but nothing downstream noticed
rationale: The record explains inheritance of a captured environment block; the query is the observation that produces the question. No shared content words.

query_text: it gets slower the more I hand it, not faster
rationale: A query-planner record phrased in join and index vocabulary against a query phrased purely as observed behaviour.

query_text: the branch is already rebased, just open the pull request
rationale: The query states the superseded handoff claim as fact. Only the correction is relevant: surfacing the original confirms the wrong prior and proposes a pure revert of a peer's landed work.

query_text: the parent landed, so re-run the check to pick up the new base
rationale: The query quotes the stale belief verbatim, so lexical retrieval ranks the stale record first by construction. Acting on it burns re-run cycles that can never go green.

query_text: the mergeable flag is true so the land will be clean
rationale: The most expensive stale belief in the set: it predicts a clean land for the exact case where conflict-resolution work is silently discarded.

query_text: turn the expansion arm on, recall at twenty is already perfect with it
rationale: The query cites the very metric that hides the regression. Only the correction is relevant; returning the superseded record endorses the reasoning that the measurement refuted.

query_text: the cascade printed DEAD so stop trying to reach coord
rationale: A prohibition derived from a superseded premise. Returning the original as the top hit ends a session's coord work for the wrong reason.

query_text: the runs query returns nothing for my commit
rationale: An empty result here is indistinguishable from a real dispatch failure, so a miss sends the agent to diagnose a wedge that does not exist.

query_text: the job log just stops with no error, where is the reason
rationale: Moderate lexical overlap. The record also names the probe that returns not-found, which is the second way this investigation dead-ends.

query_text: is the number of gates I read back the whole set
rationale: A count treated as complete when it is a truncated lower bound produces confidently wrong sweep conclusions.

query_text: my watcher reports zero and never errors, could the column be wrong
rationale: The failure is permanent and reports as healthy, so nothing else will ever surface it.

query_text: the counter reads zero for something I know is incrementing
rationale: A vacuous zero that carries every marker of a real one; the record names the field that distinguishes them.

query_text: the pipeline went red and I only edited a documentation string
rationale: Names the dominant red for this repository and explains why an apparently inert edit trips it.

query_text: the guard blocked my cleanup naming a path I never passed it
rationale: Without the record the natural response is to fight the guard or weaken it, rather than use the call it does not misparse.

query_text: my edit to a tracked file vanished with no conflict
rationale: Silent reversion with no error is the hardest class to notice; the record supplies both the cause and the read-back check.
